in_sanskrit.name: Saini
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Saini एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Saini is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sri' which means wealth or fortune. The name Saini is a tribute to the Goddess Lakshmi, the Hindu deity of wealth, prosperity, and abundance.

in_hindi.name: सानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: Farmers or landowners in Punjabi community

in_marathi.name: Saini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Saini is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sri' which means wealth or fortune. The name Saini is a tribute to the Goddess Lakshmi, the Hindu deity of wealth, prosperity, and abundance.
